latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Video AI Joy.
- Instantly turns uploaded photos (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC) into 1080p MP4 videos with AI-powered animation and smooth transitions.
- Fast setup: automatic authentication and session creation for new users; supports 100 free credits per token.
- Supports social media-friendly exports, batch processing, and real-time project editing with timeline summaries.
- Automated error handling and concise feedback for common edge cases (credits, file size, supported formats, etc.).
- Streamlined user prompts with no need for manual configuration or complex animation software.
